title: Free AI Site Approval + Nuisance Control
desc: Classify every browser action by intended effect (5-Level: passive/nuisance/workflow/state-mutation/quota/legal) and enforce approval policy before execution.
steps: Classify the intended effect using the 5-Level model: 0=passive, 1=cosmetic/nuisance, 2=workflow-continuation, 3=state-mutation, 4=economic/quota, 5=legal/identity. Classify by ACTION not UI element type.
Check docs/free-ai-sites-approval.md for site-specific gate rules and quota_sensitive flags before acting.
Level 0-2 actions: proceed automatically. Log the action with site, selector, text, classification, and decision.
Level 3-5 actions: stop and ask the user for explicit approval before proceeding. Never infer approval from prior context.
Cookie banners: auto-dismiss only Reject-all / Necessary-only / X-close paths (Level 1). Treat Accept-all / personalization / ad-targeting as Level 3 state mutation.
Rate limits: if continuation would consume scarce quota, paid entitlement, or irreversible allocation, treat as Level 4 and ask. Pure capacity limits (overload, truncation) are Level 0.
Never auto-dismiss: confirm, beforeunload, alert, sign-in, age/region gates, payment forms, OAuth, CAPTCHA, data export/delete (Level 3-5).
After auto-action, probe once to confirm the blocker is gone. If still blocked, escalate one level and re-evaluate.
Record site, gate level, action text, selector, decision, and outcome in the run log. On Level 3-5 decisions also record user response.

requirements.expect: Free AI Site Approval + Nuisance Control
